rules.requirement: The exact Associates statement appears on the site.
rules.quote: "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases."
rules.where_enforced: The strip under the masthead of every page, repeated in every footer, and again on the disclosure page. Generated by tools/build.py; the gate fails if the statement is missing from any page.

rules.requirement: Disclosure is clear and conspicuous near affiliate links.
rules.quote: A clear disclosure could be as simple as "(paid link)", "#ad", or "#CommissionsEarned" ... placed near any affiliate link or product review in a location that customers will notice easily.
rules.where_enforced: Every product card and review page carries a '(paid link)' label on the button itself, plus the disclosure strip above it.

rules.requirement: Disclose the affiliate relationship near the link and in the content.
rules.quote: You should disclose the affiliate relationship both in the videos and in the description near the links.
rules.where_enforced: Disclosure strip at the top of each page, inline '(paid link)' on every outbound button, and a full disclosure section in the footer.

rules.requirement: Do not display prices or availability unless Amazon serves the link or the data comes from Creators API / PA API.
rules.quote: your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API
rules.where_enforced: No price appears anywhere on the site. Every buy button says 'Check current price at Amazon'. tools/check_site.py fails the build if a currency pattern appears in generated HTML.

rules.requirement: Do not display star ratings or customer reviews without a PA API link.
rules.quote: You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through the PA API
rules.where_enforced: No star rating or review count appears on the site. build.py refuses to render a rating field if one is ever added to the data.

rules.requirement: Associates tag must appear as a URL parameter on every outbound Amazon link.
rules.quote: you must include your Associates ID or "tag" (appearing as XXXXX-##, or such other format as we may designate) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.
rules.where_enforced: Partially. build.py refuses to emit an outbound link that lacks tag=shopnow047c-20, so today the site renders zero buy buttons and explains why on each product page. See FLG-003.

rules.requirement: Site must contain original content, not a copy of Amazon copy.
rules.quote: Your Site(s) must contain original content ... Original content utilizing third-party materials must contain significant commentary, analysis, or transformation
rules.where_enforced: Every guide is written for this site; specification tables cite the manufacturer and are presented with a decision framing. No Amazon copy is republished.

rules.requirement: No price tracking or price alerting functionality.
rules.quote: Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.
rules.where_enforced: No price is stored, tracked, charted, or alerted. The data schema has no price field.

rules.requirement: Do not make inaccurate or misleading claims about a product.
rules.quote: You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product
rules.where_enforced: Each spec carries a source ID and an access date. Fields with conflicting sources are blank and listed on the Flagged for Review page.

rules.requirement: Do not imply Amazon sponsors or endorses the site.
rules.quote: You will not misrepresent or embellish our relationship with you (including by expressing or implying that we support, sponsor, or endorse you)
rules.where_enforced: The footer states the site is independent and not endorsed by Amazon, next to the required statement.

rules.requirement: Do not put Special Links in client-side software or offline material.
rules.quote: You will not engage in any Promotional Activities in any offline manner ... or any Special Link in connection with any printed material, ebook, mailing, or any oral solicitation.
rules.where_enforced: The site is web-only. The RSS feed carries guide links, not affiliate links.

rules.requirement: Disclosure must be unavoidable and placed where readers will see it.
rules.quote: if your disclosure is only at the beginning, you and the brand that paid you shouldn't provide consumers with a link to your review that bypasses the beginning and skips over the disclosure
rules.where_enforced: The strip sits immediately under the masthead, before any product content, on every page including the disclosure page itself. There are no anchor shortcuts that skip it.

events.name: page_view
events.when: Every page load excluding bot user agents

events.name: outbound_product_click
events.when: A reader activates a product link or 'check price' button

events.name: guide_read
events.when: A guide stays in view for 30 seconds

events.name: suggestion_vote
events.when: A reader records a preference in the suggestions queue

events.name: disclosure_view
events.when: The disclosure strip enters the viewport

event_notes: These five events are the entire measurement surface. No identifiers, cookies, fingerprinting, or cross-site data. destination_host is recorded as a hostname only, never a full URL with parameters, so no Amazon session data is stored.
